question.text: Income from Net Investment Hedge is recognized:

answer.text: Directly in equity (similar to cash flow hedge treatment)
In the profit and loss statement

explanation.text: The Logic: Net investment hedge: gains/losses on the hedging instrument are recognized in equity (OCI) to the extent effective. This matches the treatment of the underlying foreign operation's translation differences. The Trap: Similar to cash flow hedges — effective portion to equity, ineffective to P&L. Cross-Exam Context: Net investment hedge treatment is tested in Series I.
